easyPrerequisites: You are able to kill Arcbound Javelineer such that it won't have a -1/-1 counter on it when it dies.
description:
Kill Arcbound Javelineer.
When Arcbound Javelineer dies, its persist ability triggers, returning Arcbound Javelineer from your graveyard to the battlefield. It will have no counters on it due to its modular ability.
Arcbound Javelineer dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight
